messages.subject: [#maptimeDavis] Vegetation Time Series in R
parts:
First, I want to thank everyone who came this week to the Mapathon. The
Cyclone relief mapping we worked on in Mozambique is now 91% completed.

Up next week for #maptimeDavis, we'll being doing a tutorial on tracking
change in vegetation over time from satellite data using R.

It's back in our regular venue
Location: 360 Shields library (DSI Classroom)
When: Tuesday Apr 12, 1 pm - 3 pm

Full details, registration link, how to prepare...
https://spatial.ucdavis.edu/2019/04/16/maptimedavis-ndvi-time-series-data-in-r/

Thanks,
--
Alex Mandel, PhD

Center for Spatial Sciences
https://spatial.ucdavis.edu
Geospatial and Farming Systems Research Consortium
https://gfc.ucdavis.edu
University of California, Davis
